title: Silence and Blue Hour
author: Wendell Blackwood
blurb: Sable Blackwood, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
